materialAdapters.Shader Forge/StandardTriplanarWorldSpace: PBR using authored UVs; world-space triplanar blending is approximated
materialAdapters.Horizon[ON]/Horizon[ON] Displacement: Source base terrain color on authored UVs; world projection and shader displacement approximated
materialAdapters.Nature/SpeedTree: Static PBR with source alpha cutout and baked bark detail; secondary detail UV and wind approximated
materialAdapters.Standard (Specular setup): Source gloss alpha converted to roughness; colored specular reflectance approximated by dielectric PBR
materialAdapters.Standard Double Sided: PBR with original textures and both faces
materialAdapters.Shader Forge/StandardShaderUV3Occlusion: PBR with baked lighting; UV3 occlusion approximated
materialAdapters.Shader Forge/WaterShader: Static source tint and combined normals; scrolling, depth fade and reflections approximated
materialAdapters.Shader Forge/WaterShaderOpaque: Static source tint and combined normals; scrolling, depth fade and reflections approximated
materialAdapters.Project/Standard/StandardTriplanarWorldS: PBR on source UVs; world triplanar projection approximated
materialAdapters.Grass Surface Shader (no zwrite): Static main atlas and source mesh; procedural grass, world tint and wind approximated
materialAdapters.GrassRenderDepth: Redundant depth-only pass hidden; source grass uses its own alpha-tested depth
materialAdapters.Horizon[ON]/Horizon[ON] TransitionTerrai: Source base color on authored UVs; terrain transition/world projection approximated
materialAdapters.Shader Forge/TreeCreatorReplacement: Static source diffuse and mesh normals; packed normal/specular shading and wind approximated
materialAdapters.Shader Forge/TreeCreatorLeavesReplacemen: Static source diffuse/cutout and mesh normals; packed normal/specular shading and wind approximated
materialAdapters.Shader Forge/VideoWall: Static source overlay; runtime video not reproduced
materialAdapters.Unity Terrain (baked source splat layers: Authored heightmap geometry with diffuse, normal, metalness and roughness baked from source terrain layer weights, tiling and textures; wind approximated
materialAdapters.Unity Terrain Detail (static source bill: Source grass atlas and authored density retained; static crossed billboards, deterministic scatter, tint and far-LOD fade adapt Unity procedural grass and wind.
materialAdapters.AFS/Foliage Shader v4: Static source fern mesh and alpha-tested atlas; packed normal, translucency, specular lighting and animated bending approximated
materialAdapters.Hidden/Nature/Tree Creator Bark Optimize: Static source bark mesh and atlas; packed normal/specular/translucency lighting and wind approximated
materialAdapters.Hidden/Nature/Tree Creator Leaves Fast O: Static source leaf mesh and alpha-tested atlas with authored cutoff; tree shadow lighting and wind approximated
materialAdapters.Hidden/Nature/Tree Creator Leaves Optimi: Static source leaf mesh and alpha-tested atlas with authored cutoff; packed normal/specular/translucency and tree shadow lighting and wind approximated
